profile.headline: Software Developer @ The HWP Group | Software Development
profile.summary:
Software Developer who turns complex workflows into fast, secure, maintainable web apps. I ship measurable impact, faster queries, fewer incidents, and clearer UX, and I care about clean architecture, testing, and observability.

Currently delivering full-stack features with C#/.NET and SQL in a regulated environment. The patterns I use (solid domain modeling, performance tuning, CI-driven quality, and pragmatic security) transfer to any industry.

Impact
• ~25% faster data retrieval via indexing, tuned T-SQL, and well-designed stored procedures
• ~25% less downtime through actionable logging/telemetry, proactive fixes, and clean releases
• 85%+ code coverage and ~35% fewer defects with disciplined reviews and automated tests
• Security hardened (secrets management, input validation/XSS prevention, encryption) with ~60% fewer security issues

Toolbox
C#, .NET (MVC, DI, EF/LINQ), ASP.NET, SQL Server (T-SQL), JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Microsoft Access/VBA, Git, Azure DevOps, Rollbar.

How I work
I partner closely with product, design, and operations to turn ambiguous requirements into maintainable features and reliable releases. I optimize for readability first, performance second, and measure both.

If you’re building dependable platforms—whether B2B, SaaS, or enterprise-connect.

volunteerExperiences.description:
As a Umiya Mataji Temple Chicago volunteer, I have contributed to the community through IT support and general assistance. My primary responsibilities include maintaining and updating the temple's website, enhancing its features for a better user experience, and assisting with day-to-day tasks around the temple. 

This opportunity has allowed me to give back to the community, improve my teamwork and communication skills, and deepen my understanding of cultural and religious diversity.

projects.title: Online Shopping Store
projects.description:
I designed and developed a comprehensive online shopping store using PHP, SQL, HTML, and CSS, creating a seamless and user-friendly platform for customers to browse and purchase products.

Key Features:

Responsive Design: The store's layout is responsive and visually appealing, ensuring optimal user experience across various devices and screen sizes.

Database Integration: Utilizing SQL, I implemented a robust database system to manage product inventory, customer information, and order processing, enabling efficient store operations.

User Authentication & Security: The shopping store includes a secure user authentication system, allowing customers to create accounts, log in, and manage their personal information and order history safely.

Easy Navigation & Search: The store offers intuitive navigation and a powerful search function, enabling customers to easily browse product categories and quickly find items of interest.

Custom Styling: Using HTML and CSS, I created a visually engaging design that reflects the store's brand identity while ensuring a consistent and enjoyable shopping experience.

This project demonstrates my ability to develop a fully functional online shopping store, incorporating various web development technologies to create a secure, user-friendly platform that enhances the customer experience.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description:
I developed a personal portfolio website showcasing my web development skills and hosting various projects demonstrating my diverse abilities. Built using HTML, CSS, jQuery, and JavaScript, this website highlights my proficiency in creating functional and visually appealing web applications.

Key Features:

Responsive Design: The website is designed to be responsive and adaptive, ensuring a seamless user experience across multiple devices and screen sizes.

Project Showcase: A dedicated section features an array of projects, such as a fully functioning online store, a tic-tac-toe game, and more, each demonstrating my expertise in different aspects of web development.

Interactive UI: Leveraging jQuery and JavaScript, I created an engaging and dynamic user interface to provide a smooth browsing experience for visitors.

This personal portfolio website serves as a platform to showcase my work and highlights my ability to create user-centric web applications with a keen eye for design and functionality.
